resources.string: Enter the address you open Voxinq at in a browser, such as https://your-pc.your-tailnet.ts.net. This phone has to be able to reach it, for example over Tailscale.
Enter an address that starts with https://, or just the host name.
Turn on Tailscale on this phone to reach the server.
Turn on Tailscale before “%1$s” at %2$s. If it stays off, the recording can be kept on the phone and sent later.
The server answers, but cannot reach its database.
%1$s did not answer. Check that the server is running and that this phone can reach it.
Shown while a meeting is being recorded
Shown when a meeting you booked is starting
It is time for this meeting (booked for %1$s).
It is time for this meeting (booked for %1$s). The server cannot be reached, so the recording is kept on the phone and sent once it can be.
Not reachable since %1$s. If it is not back for “%2$s” at %3$s, the recording can be kept on the phone and sent once it is.
Android did not let the app use the microphone from here. Open Voxinq and record from the meeting.
The microphone could not be started. Open Voxinq and record from the meeting.
Could not get the recording ready: %1$s
Shown while a shared recording is being sent

%1$s — %2$s
A new meeting is created and the audio is transcribed on your server.
Sent — being transcribed on the server. Tap to open the meeting.
Open Voxinq once and enter your server address first.
That is not an audio file this app can read.
That file could not be read from the app that shared it.
A meeting is being recorded. Try again once it has finished.
Start recording a meeting, or set one up, in one tap
Saved on this phone, and sent to be transcribed once the server answers.
Recording carries on with the screen off. It is transcribed once it reaches the server.
On this phone, waiting to be sent
Delete this recording from the phone? It has not been sent.
Recording needs permission to use the microphone.
Another meeting is being recorded in the app. Stop it first.
Could not write the audio to this phone: %1$s
Kept on this phone: %1$d seconds of audio and %2$d line(s) not sent yet. The app sends them when it next reaches the server.
Sending audio kept from an interrupted recording…
The transcription service has been unreachable for over five minutes, so the oldest audio is being dropped.
No app on this phone can open %1$s
